newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Sport-NZ A win toss and bat vs England.
newsitem.headline: NZ Sport-NZ A win toss and bat vs England.

text.p: New Zealand A won the toss and will bat first in their four-day cricket match against England starting at Victoria Park, Wanganui, on Thursday.
It was the first toss out of five on tour that England skipper Mike Atherton has lost.
England omitted fast-medium bowlers Dominic Cork, Darren Gough and Alan Mullally and first-test century-makers Alec Stewart and Graham Thorpe.
England: Mike Atherton (captain), Nick Knight, Nasser Hussain, John Crawley, Craig White, Ronnie Irani, Jack Russell, Robert Croft, Andrew Caddick, Chris Silverwood, Phil Tufnell.
New Zealand A: Darrin Murray (captain), Phil Chandler, Craig Spearman, Matt Horne, Llorne Howell, Chris Harris, Jason Mills, Paul Wiseman, Robert Kennedy, Geoff Allott, Heath Davis.
